label: U.S. Treasury 2024–2025
source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates, 2Y/5Y/10Y.
scope: Bond-only hypothetical book. Equity and FX positions are excluded; their zero factor placeholders are never used for risk.
calendar: Official published observation dates. First level is consumed to form changes; no filling or interpolation.
usage_basis: Numerical observations from a public U.S. federal government statistical release; source attribution retained. No third-party equity dataset redistributed.
retrieval_method: Official annual HTML tables; extracted by labelled 2 Yr, 5 Yr, 10 Yr columns.
